summary: Require actual initialized/live requests, subscription ownership and occupancy before collision/cap/throwing-subscribe refusals.
Use entered permission/open gates, complete seeded audio/media payloads, actual frame-reader caps and independent UTF8 envelopes.
Transfer unique private native/notify/identity/route/chunk controls into actual host and public-reader behavior before deleting suites.
